# Endvour – OpenCode Free Usage Limit Bypass Plugin

## What It Does
Endvour injects the official OpenCode client headers into every request, bypassing the 429 FreeUsageLimitError.

## Installation

### Method 1 – Plugin Config
Add to `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`:
```json
{
  "plugin": ["endvour"]
}
